name: mission-control
description: Mission Control — the master session that plans regenloop programs, forges red-teamed session prompts, verifies results against reality, and distills knowledge into the memory vault

plugins.name: mission-control
plugins.description: Master-session orchestrator for multi-session regenloop programs: plan waves and lanes, forge red-teamed session prompts from fresh recon, verify returning sessions against reality (never their self-reports), and distill the program into the Basic Memory vault before deleting its working docs. Never implements; never merges, releases, or deploys — those stay human.
